paragraphs.text: Unreal orders of things arise, and the mechanism is delusion: shining things get darkened, and the not-self gets taken for the self, burst upon burst. The self nets itself the way a spider nets itself in its own web. But unwrapped, the supreme Shiva spreads out the play of bondage and release. States of waking, dreaming, sleeping shine inside a fourth that stays unveiled — the three told, the fourth beyond telling. Sky unsoiled, jars unsoiled.
